Transistor Gallery#

Every MOSFET circuit of Transistor Circuits on one sheet, for reference: 65 circuits, each with its name and one line. Point at a transistor or a resistor to read what it is; click to keep it marked.

gallery([
    ('The Two Types', [
        (C.n_type, ''),
        (C.p_type, ''),
    ]),
    ('One Transistor: Eight Roles', [
        (C.role_amplifier, r'$A_v=-g_mR_D$'),
        (C.role_follower, r'$A_v=\dfrac{g_mR_S}{1+g_mR_S}$'),
        (C.role_current_buffer, r'$I_\mathrm{out}=I_\mathrm{in}$, $R_\mathrm{in}\approx1/g_m$'),
        (C.role_current_source, r'$I_\mathrm{out}=\frac{1}{2}\mu_nC_{ox}(W/L)(V_\mathrm{bias}-V_{TH})^2$, $R_\mathrm{out}=r_O$'),
        (C.role_diode, r'$R=1/g_m$ above $V_{TH}$'),
        (C.role_switch, r'$R_\mathrm{on}=\left[\mu_nC_{ox}(W/L)(V_{GS}-V_{TH})\right]^{-1}$'),
        (C.role_resistor, r'$R_\mathrm{on}=\left[\mu_nC_{ox}(W/L)(V_{GS}-V_{TH})\right]^{-1}$, triode'),
        (C.role_capacitor, r'$C\approx WLC_{ox}$'),
    ]),
    ('One Transistor: Impedances', [
        (C.into_base, ''),
        (C.into_collector, ''),
        (C.into_collector_degenerated, ''),
        (C.into_emitter, ''),
    ]),
    ('One Transistor: Gains', [
        (C.gain_common_emitter, r'$A_v=-g_m(R_D\parallel r_O)$'),
        (C.gain_degenerated, r'$A_v=-\dfrac{R_D}{\dfrac{1}{g_m}+R_S}$'),
        (C.gain_common_base, r'$A_v=\dfrac{R_D}{\dfrac{1}{g_m}+R_S}$'),
        (C.gain_follower, r'$A_v=\dfrac{R_S\parallel r_O}{\dfrac{1}{g_m}+R_S\parallel r_O}$'),
    ]),
    ('Two Transistors: Bias Circuits', [
        (C.voltage_divider, r'$V_\mathrm{out}=V_\mathrm{in}/2$, matched devices'),
        (C.ptat_generator, r'$V_\mathrm{ptat}=V_T\ln(1+K)$ with $V_T=kT/q$'),
        (C.bias_generator, r'$V_\mathrm{bias}=V_{GS2}$'),
        (C.tie_cell, r'Output held at ground through $M_2$'),
        (C.current_mirror, r'$I_\mathrm{out}=\dfrac{(W/L)_2}{(W/L)_1}\,I_\mathrm{in}$'),
        (C.current_divider, r'$I_\mathrm{in}$ splits in the ratio of the sizes'),
    ]),
    ('Two Transistors: Gain Stages', [
        (C.active_load, r'$A_v=-g_{m1}(r_{O1}\parallel r_{O2})$'),
        (C.inverter, r'$A_v=-(g_{m1}+g_{m2})(r_{O1}\parallel r_{O2})$'),
        (C.diode_load, r'$A_v=-\dfrac{g_{m1}}{g_{m2}}=-\sqrt{\dfrac{(W/L)_1}{(W/L)_2}}$'),
        (C.folded_diode_load, r'$A_v=-\dfrac{g_{m1}}{g_{m2}}$, no body effect'),
        (C.degeneration, r'$M_2$ in triode'),
        (C.tunable_degeneration, r'$G_m=\dfrac{g_{m1}}{1+g_{m1}R_\mathrm{on2}}$'),
    ]),
    ('Two Transistors: Buffers', [
        (C.follower, r'$V_\mathrm{out}=V_\mathrm{in}-V_{GS1}$, $R_\mathrm{out}\approx1/g_{m1}$'),
        (C.push_pull, r'$|V_\mathrm{in}-V_\mathrm{out}|<V_{TH}$'),
        (C.buffer_stage, r'$R_\mathrm{in}\approx1/g_{m1}$'),
        (C.stacked_buffers, r'$R_\mathrm{out}$ rises by $g_mr_O$ per device'),
        (C.two_outputs, r'Outputs $\mp g_mV_\mathrm{in}$, $R_\mathrm{in}\approx1/g_{m2}$'),
        (C.two_paths, r'$A_v=1+\dfrac{g_{m2}}{g_{m1}}$'),
    ]),
    ('Two Transistors: Feedback Pairs', [
        (C.cascode, r'$R_\mathrm{out}\approx g_{m2}r_{O2}\,r_{O1}$'),
        (C.regulated_cascode, r'$R_\mathrm{out}$ times $g_{m2}r_{O2}$ once more'),
        (C.flipped_follower, r'$V_\mathrm{out}=V_\mathrm{in}-V_{GS1}$, $R_\mathrm{out}\approx\dfrac{1}{g_{m1}\,g_{m2}r_{O1}}$'),
        (C.active_inductor, r'$L\approx\dfrac{C_{GS1}}{g_{m1}g_{m2}}$ in parallel with $1/g_{m2}$'),

        (C.cross_coupled_pair, r'$R=-2/g_m$ between the two drains'),
    ]),
    ('Two Transistors: Circuit Elements', [
        (C.controlled_resistor, r'$R=\dfrac{(W/L)_2}{(W/L)_1}\cdot\dfrac{1}{g_{m2}}$'),
        (C.large_resistor, r'Very large $R$: both devices nearly off'),
        (C.varactor, r'$C$ tuned by $V_\mathrm{bias}$'),
        (C.antiparallel_capacitors, r'$C(V)$ is symmetric about zero'),
        (C.antiparallel_diodes, r'Conducts when $|V_p-V_n|$ exceeds $V_{TH}$'),
        (C.low_leakage_diode, r'Reverse bias turns both devices off harder'),
        (C.level_shift, r'$V_p-V_n=V_{GS1}+V_{GS2}$'),
        (C.linear_i_to_v, r'$R_\mathrm{in}=\dfrac{1}{g_{m1}+g_{m2}}$, constant'),
    ]),
    ('Two Transistors: Switched Circuits', [
        (C.transmission_gate, r'Conducts from rail to rail'),
        (C.multiplexer, r'$V_\mathrm{com}=V_1$ or $V_2$'),
        (C.sample_and_hold, r'Tracks while $M_1$ is on, holds on $M_2$'),
        (C.low_pass, r'$f_{-3\,\mathrm{dB}}=\dfrac{1}{2\pi R_\mathrm{on1}C_2}$'),
        (C.peak_detector, r'$V_\mathrm{peak}=\hat V_\mathrm{in}-V_{GS1}$'),
        (C.voltage_doubler, r'Peaks near $2\hat V_\mathrm{in}-V_{GS2}$'),
    ]),
    ('Two Transistors: Logic Gates', [
        (C.nand, r'$V_\mathrm{out}=\overline{V_a\wedge V_b}$'),
        (C.nor, r'$V_\mathrm{out}=\overline{V_a\vee V_b}$'),
        (C.xnor, r'$V_\mathrm{out}=\overline{V_a\oplus V_b}$'),
        (C.mixer, r'$I_\mathrm{out}\propto(V_\mathrm{rf}-V_{TH})\,V_{DS1}$'),
    ]),
    ('Two-Stage Op Amp', [
        (C.op_amp_pair, r'$I_1-I_2=g_m(V_1-V_2)$'),
        (C.op_amp_tail, r'$I_1+I_2=I_{D5}$'),
        (C.op_amp_mirror, r'$A_v=g_{m1}(r_{O2}\parallel r_{O4})$'),
        (C.op_amp_second, r'$A_v=-g_{m1}(r_{O2}\parallel r_{O4})\,g_{m6}(r_{O6}\parallel r_{O7})$'),
        (C.op_amp_bias, r'$I_{D5}$ and $I_{D7}$ copy $I_\mathrm{ref}$ in the ratio of $W/L$'),
    ]),
], device=MOSFET, columns=4)
